CREATE TABLE "public"."ad_accounts" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_ad_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone_name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ad_insight_daily" (
  "ad_id" text NOT NULL,
  "ad_set_id" text NOT NULL,
  "attribution_windows" text NOT NULL,
  "campaign_id" text NOT NULL,
  "clicks" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "impressions" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "purchase_value" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "purchases" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "raw_actions_json" jsonb,
  "spend" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "synced_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ad_set_versions" (
  "ad_set_id" text NOT NULL,
  "effective_status" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "valid_from" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valid_to" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ad_set_versions_effective_status_check_4695fc4a" CHECK ("effective_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "ad_set_versions_status_check_8334ea1b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ad_sets" (
  "billing_event" text,
  "campaign_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_name" text NOT NULL,
  "current_status" text NOT NULL,
  "daily_budget" numeric,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lifetime_budget" numeric,
  "meta_ad_set_id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_created_time" timestamptz,
  "optimization_goal" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ad_sets_current_status_check_b05be3ef" CHECK ("current_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ad_versions" (
  "ad_id" text NOT NULL,
  "effective_status" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "valid_from" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valid_to" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ad_versions_effective_status_check_4695fc4a" CHECK ("effective_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "ad_versions_status_check_8334ea1b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ads" (
  "ad_set_id" text NOT NULL,
  "campaign_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creative_meta_id" text,
  "current_name" text NOT NULL,
  "current_status" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_ad_id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_created_time" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ads_current_status_check_b05be3ef" CHECK ("current_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."campaign_versions" (
  "campaign_id" text NOT NULL,
  "effective_status" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "valid_from" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valid_to" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "campaign_versions_effective_status_check_4695fc4a" CHECK ("effective_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "campaign_versions_status_check_8334ea1b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."campaigns" (
  "ad_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_name" text NOT NULL,
  "current_status" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_campaign_id" text NOT NULL,
  "meta_created_time" timestamptz,
  "objective" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "campaigns_current_status_check_b05be3ef" CHECK ("current_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'DELETED', 'ARCHIVED', 'IN_PROCESS', 'WITH_ISSUES', 'CAMPAIGN_PAUSED', 'ADSET_PAUSED', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "currency" text,
  "external_order_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imported_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ordered_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "raw_row_json" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "utm_campaign" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sync_cursors" (
  "ad_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "last_successful_sync_at" timestamptz,
  "last_synced_through_date" date NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sync_runs" (
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "error_message" text,
  "finished_at" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "rows_upserted" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'RUNNING' NOT NULL,
  "window_end" date,
  "window_start" date,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sync_runs_entity_type_check_20a29848" CHECK ("entity_type" IN ('HIERARCHY', 'INSIGHTS')),
  CONSTRAINT "sync_runs_status_check_5c3c95c5" CHECK ("status" IN ('RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'))
)
